items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And Johnny said to me, "Well I heard that you didn't have much luck out on the road, and I know you from Old Man Baron's place, how would you like to work for us?"

ctx.x: Well, when we come back off the road from

the "Plantation Days" where we got stranded and we had helped and all all the girls get home. I run into an old buddy of mine from the war. And he said, "Sam, what are you doing." And I said, "Doing nothing and going nowhere fast." So, he said to me, "Well, how would you like to go down to Johnny Carey and MAL Frazier, they are opening a new club. And they're looking for an orchestra leader and they'll put a band in there, and I said, "What size band?" And he said, "Well, you come on and see Johnny." And Johnny…
it was a gentleman's agreement. If you can call them gentlemen.
